title: Australian Flatbread
description: A low-carb flatbread recipe inspired by Australian cuisine, perfect for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Australian Flatbread Dough
ingredients.notes: Low-carb dough made with almond flour and eggs.

ingredients.name: Mature Cheddar Cheese
ingredients.notes: Aged cheddar adds a rich flavor to this flatbread.

ingredients.name: Fresh Chives
ingredients.notes: Chopped chives add a fresh and oniony flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper enhances the flavor of the cheese.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Eggs help bind the dough together.

ingredients.name: Almond Flour
ingredients.notes: A low-carb flour made from almonds.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Melted butter adds a rich flavor to the flatbread.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine almond flour, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the dough until it forms a ball.
Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal pieces, depending on the size of flatbread you prefer.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place the flatbreads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with melted butter.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the flatbreads are golden brown.
Remove from oven and top with mature cheddar cheese and fresh chives.
Return to oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
